name: civicbestiary
description: The Civic Bestiary - a field guide to the creatures of the body politic, generated from one dataset into a README and a prestruct-prerendered static site.

scripts.build: python3 build.py && python3 build_site.py && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: python3 build.py --check && python3 build_site.py --check && npm run lint:packs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run audit

author: dhaupin
